content:
**Never use drain cleaner in food.**

Drain cleaner is a highly corrosive and poisonous substance. It is dangerous to ingest or even come into contact with. Using it in your waffle batter could cause serious injury or death.

If you want blue waffles, use food coloring or other natural food-safe dyes.
